text.p: Catering services supplies Spotless Services Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected to make satisfactory progress in its results for the year to June 30, 1997.

"Directors expect that the full year 1997 results will make satisfactory progress above 1996 in the absence of any significant change in present trading patterns," chairman Brian Blythe told shareholders at the annual meeting.
Spotless Services, which is about 69 percent owned by Spotless Group Ltd, reported a net profit of A$20.27 million in 1995/96, compared with A$18.82 million a year ago.

Blythe told shareholders at the Spotless Group annual meeting, which was held after the Spotless Services meeting, that Spotless Services results for the first quarter of 1996/97 had begun well despite a slower Australian economy.

"Against this background SSL (Spotless Services) profits for 1997 have begun well for the first quarter, supported by stronger than expected profit performance from plastics in September and October 1996," Blythe said.
